params.body:
`kubo-it-lab` and `menukaart-webapp` were refused with "nothing to set: no open headers task" while three headers of the safe set were missing on both. A task opens at `month`; a site missing only the lighter headers is judged `background`, and the gate asked for a task instead of asking the measurement.

The gate now reads `safeHeadersMissing` from the exposure measurement: more than none is work this hand can do. Two other refusals stay distinct: the site already sends the whole safe set, and the measurement has not run since the hand existed.

Portal learns no header names and no threshold; the worklist is unchanged, so a background row still has no button. What changes is that an agent (or you, through the API) may ask for work that is not urgent.
params.title: Urgency decides what the worklist shows, not whether a hand may work
